# The Lead Hunter Club

> The real-time B2B intent discovery and client acquisition engine for freelancers, agency owners, and service providers.

## Overview
The Lead Hunter Club (https://theleadhunterclub.com) monitors live public discussions across LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Reddit, Threads, and developer communities where decision-makers actively state urgent problems or request contractor recommendations.

## Value Proposition
- High Intent: Identifies decision-makers asking for services right now instead of cold-pitching static directory lists.
- AI Buyer Intelligence: Synthesizes pain points, task scope, budget signals, and recommended pitch angles.
- Automated Contact Enrichment: Extracts and verifies emails, phone numbers, and profile URLs.
- Anti-Saturation Gate: Capped at 25 unlocks per lead or expires in 48 hours to protect conversion rates.

## Core Services & Lead Niches
- Web & App Development (React, Next.js, Node.js, Full Stack, Mobile, Python, AI Integrations)
- UI/UX & Product Design (Figma, Landing Pages, Mobile Apps, Design Systems)
- Paid Ads & Performance Marketing (Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads)
- SEO & Content Marketing (B2B SaaS, Technical Writing, Copywriting)
- AI & Workflow Automation (Make, n8n, AI Agents, Python Automations)
- Video Editing & Motion Graphics (Short-form, YouTube, 3D Animation)

## Pricing & Wallet Economics
- Free Starter: ₹0/mo — 50 monthly credits, 15-day rollover, zero credit card required.
- Freelancer Pro: ₹999/mo — 1,000 monthly credits, 15-day rollover, priority support.
- Top-Up Credit Packs: 125 credits (₹199), 275 credits (₹399), 450 credits (₹599) — never expire.
- Reveal Costs: Phone & Email (15 credits), Phone only (12 credits), Email only (10 credits), Profile only (5 credits).
